content.title: Retro Handheld | Farewell Glance
content.summary: A handheld observer discovers the character inside an everyday routine. One external cue changes the character's immediate goal; after a single acknowledgment, a motivated framing or focus error gives the departure a memory-like ending.

quick_start.input_format: Handheld observer perspective + everyday subject and place + two routine actions + external cue changes the goal + one acknowledgment + motivated recording error
quick_start.recommended_input: A home camera records the pool manager gathering up the floatation board and locking the locker door. A whistle in the distance causes her to change direction; she turns back and waves once, but the photographer briefly loses focus and cuts to the water's surface while following the shot.
required_anchors: At least two ordinary daily actions
A response followed by a motivated error to conclude
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The observer first discovers the character's daily life, external signals change the character's goals, and after one response, it ends with a motivated shooting mistake.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: An imperfect continuous observer discovers a subject already engaged in an ordinary routine, lingers through small unperformed actions, then lets one external environmental cue change the subject's goal. A single late acknowledgment briefly closes the distance between subject and operator before a motivated exit and imperfect recording finish. Place, subject, routine, cue, medium defects, acknowledgment and exit remain variable.

invariants.rule: Begin with the operator discovering the subject inside a legible everyday geography rather than presenting a perfect hero frame.
invariants.purpose: Establishes a lived observer relationship and makes later acknowledgment meaningful.
invariants.ablation_failure: A polished centered opening feels staged and removes the sense of a found private memory.

invariants.rule: Give the subject at least two low-amplitude routine actions before the external cue arrives.
invariants.purpose: Builds personality and temporal patience without dialogue or plot exposition.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the cue arrives immediately, the clip becomes a generic arrival or departure shot with no remembered life.

invariants.rule: Use one visible or audible environmental cue to cause a clear change of goal inside the same continuous geography.
invariants.purpose: Creates narrative motion without a cut or scripted speech.
invariants.ablation_failure: An uncaused exit feels arbitrary; multiple competing cues fragment attention.

invariants.rule: Reserve one brief direct acknowledgment of the operator for the threshold just before exit.
invariants.purpose: Turns detached observation into a personal memory while keeping the behavior candid.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated posing feels performative; no acknowledgment leaves the observer relationship emotionally unused.

invariants.rule: Let medium imperfections follow operator attention—late focus, overshoot, exposure correction or a missed finish—without obscuring the causal action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the capture feel human while protecting readability.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random constant shake becomes a filter; flawless coverage loses the memory texture; defects at the cue can hide the story.

slots.name: memory_medium
slots.constraint: One era-appropriate consumer format with a specific, restrained defect profile.

slots.name: everyday_place
slots.constraint: A coherent public or private location whose geography supports one continuous take.

slots.name: subject_identity
slots.constraint: An original person with stable appearance, clothing and relationship to the operator.

slots.name: routine_actions
slots.constraint: Two or three small actions with props native to the place.

slots.name: external_cue
slots.constraint: One event that visibly changes the subject's goal.

slots.name: acknowledgment
slots.constraint: One brief glance, nod, gesture or shared joke near exit.

slots.name: exit_path
slots.constraint: A physically continuous departure through the established geography.

slots.name: operator_mistake
slots.constraint: One motivated focus, zoom, framing or endpoint error that remains readable.

anti_copy_exclusions: coastal railway platform, Korean signs, sea-facing parallel tracks, silver commuter train and weathered bench
young Korean woman, beige trench coat, blue jeans, brown shoulder bag, takeaway coffee and source appearance
exact stand-sit-sip-train-wave-board sequence and exact fifteen-second boundaries
source early-2000s MiniDV brand/profile, heavy shake pattern, autofocus targets, exposure behavior and downward platform finish

instantiations.concept: A late-1990s Hi8 home video at a neighborhood community pool discovers a young adult lifeguard stacking kickboards and folding towels; the motorized pool cover starts, he shoulders a duffel, gives the operator one small come-on nod and exits through a chain gate as the camera overshoots.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Unbroken after-hours pool memory with routine cleanup, pool-cover cue, one late nod and a human Hi8 miss at the gate.

instantiations.concept: A small-town bakery closing video on consumer VHS-C follows an older baker brushing flour and tying bread bags; a delivery bell and rolling shutter door trigger departure, she taps the lens hood playfully once and leaves through the back alley while white balance drifts under fluorescent light.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Bakery closing memory using flour routines, delivery cue, one playful acknowledgment and fluorescent VHS-C imperfections.

instantiations.concept: A handheld pocket-DV clip at an amateur observatory finds a teenage volunteer wiping eyepieces and checking a star chart; the dome slit begins closing at dawn, she salutes the operator with the lens cap and follows the stairwell out while focus lingers on the empty telescope.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Observatory dawn memory with equipment routine, dome cue, lens-cap salute and an imperfect empty-object finish.

failure_modes.failure: The subject poses for the camera throughout.
failure_modes.repair: Keep attention on routine actions until one brief acknowledgment immediately before exit.

failure_modes.failure: Analog defects are applied at constant maximum intensity.
failure_modes.repair: Tie each focus, exposure or framing error to an operator correction and preserve the external cue.

failure_modes.failure: The cue and exit are unrelated.
failure_modes.repair: Show the cue entering the established geography, then stage one visible goal change before the exit path.

failure_modes.failure: The transfer simply replaces the train station with another stop.
failure_modes.repair: Change place class, routine, cue mechanics, subject-operator relation, medium format and exit behavior together.
